Method of Attack: Encrypting servers and data using Windows BitLocker and DiskCryptor software to lock disk partitions with a password
Leaving ransom notes named ransom.txt on domain controllers and backup servers
Targeting servers holding large amounts of files such as file servers and backup servers
Using off-the-shelf encryption software instead of traditional ransomware
Communicating ransom demands via ransom notes containing a Bitmessage ID
Indicators of Compromise: ransom.txt ransom notes on domain controllers and backup servers
